_readme: [CastleMystery 2026-10-15] Castle Startle numbers (Base/CastleMystery/CastleStartle.cs re-reads this file on change). OFFICIAL = client data, DERIVED = not in the client, balanced, change freely.
_shop: OFFICIAL: luacfg EmoneySaleShop[33978] (Suyi): Castle Key 20 CPs, Fine Castle Key Box 199 CPs max 20, Grand Castle Key Box 999 CPs max 5 (per character per event year).
_boxes: OFFICIAL item texts: Fine = 10 + 1 additional Castle Keys, Grand = 50 + 5 additional.
_castlePoints: DERIVED: Castle Points per used key (official text: keys 'accumulate Castle Points for rankings'; the ranking is cross-server, so the points are only shown).
_anthony: OFFICIAL: Lord Anthony gives 'a key' after a chat ([Sys][ADNTip]); once a day is DERIVED.
_keyTreasure: DERIVED: what 1 Castle Key gives in the treasure chamber = Chocolate Candy 3352015 (the currency of the official Castle Store). Average ~57 Candy per key, so a 3600-Candy Romantic box needs about 63 keys (~1260 CPs at the official 20 CPs a key).
